newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel soars with NYMEX, but diffs steady.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel soars with NYMEX, but diffs steady.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices soared nearly three cents a gallon higher Wednesday tracking a big NYMEX heating oil futures move, but activity in spot markets was exceedingly quiet by comparison, traders said.
Prompt barrels of 54-grade airline-quality material were heard done at just below the price of December futures, but diffs faded later in the session, partly in response to the sharp NYMEX move.
In New York Harbor, prompt 54-grade was offered at 2.50 cents over December NYMEX, but bids were too scarce to even assess accurately, traders said.
Low sulphur 55-grade jet fuel markets were even thinner, with prompt barrels in NYH talked at about 3.25 cents over December NYMEX and at 0.50 cent over at the U.S. Gulf.
-- Oliver Ludwig New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
